description: Accepted neutral words by card or command owner. Names are case-sensitive. Parameter names are listed separately. This vocabulary contains no external keywords or aliases.

designFields.BarProp: area, bendingInertia1, bendingInertia2, torsionConstant, nonStructMass, stressPointCy, stressPointCz, stressPointDy, stressPointDz, stressPointEy, stressPointEz, stressPointFy, stressPointFz, shearFactor1, shearFactor2, productInertia12
designFields.BeamProp: area, bendingInertia1, bendingInertia2, productInertia12, torsionConstant, nonStructMass, stressPointCy to stressPointFz with a station (EndA), (EndB) or (i), and shearFactor1, shearFactor2, shearRelief1, shearRelief2, nsmInertia(EndA), nsmInertia(EndB), warpingCoefficient(EndA), warpingCoefficient(EndB), nsmCenterY(EndA), nsmCenterZ(EndA), nsmCenterY(EndB), nsmCenterZ(EndB), neutralAxisY(EndA), neutralAxisZ(EndA), neutralAxisY(EndB), neutralAxisZ(EndB)
designFields.BeamShapeProp: dimension(1), dimension(2), ... and nonStructMass, each with an optional station (EndA), (EndB) or (i)
designFields.CompProp: bottomOffset, nonStructMass, bondAllowable, referenceTemperature, structuralDamping, plyThickness(1), plyThickness(2), ..., plyAngle(1), plyAngle(2), ...
designFields.CompPropGlobal: bottomOffset, nonStructMass, bondAllowable, referenceTemperature, structuralDamping, plyThickness(1), plyThickness(2), ..., plyAngle(1), plyAngle(2), ...
designFields.IsoMat: youngsModulus, shearModulus, poissonRatio, density, thermalExpansion, referenceTemperature, structuralDamping, tensionAllowable, compressionAllowable, shearAllowable
designFields.OrthoMat2D: youngsModulus1, youngsModulus2, poissonRatio12, shearModulus12, shearModulus1Z, shearModulus2Z, density, thermalExpansion1, thermalExpansion2, referenceTemperature, tensionStrength1, compressionStrength1, tensionStrength2, compressionStrength2, shearStrength, structuralDamping, interactionTerm12, strainAllowables
designFields.PointMassInertia: mass, offset1, offset2, offset3, inertia11, inertia21, inertia22, inertia31, inertia32, inertia33
designFields.ShellProp: thickness, shearThicknessRatio, nonStructMass, fiberDistance1, fiberDistance2 and bendingStiffnessRatio

textGrammars.BarArbitrarySectionProp: description contains comma-separated items: outerPerimeter=id, outerMesh=id, innerPerimeter(index)=id, branch(index)=id, thickness(index)=value, core(index)=propertyId, layer(index)=[propertyId,setId], nonStructMass=value. Thickness and core values can select points with [value,points=(startId,endId)].
textGrammars.BeamArbitrarySectionProp: description uses the same exact item names as BarArbitrarySectionProp, restricted to the items supported by this section form.
textGrammars.LineInterface: boundaryList is boundaries=(id, id(Linear), id(Quadratic), ...). A bare ID uses Linear interpolation; the sign identifies an independent boundary. All names use exact case.
textGrammars.ExplicitParam: Rigid-body designators of RigidBodyMerge and RigidBodyMerge1 use RigidAssembly(id) or RigidMat(id), with a positive ID and exact case.
